payload.title: Specify the local store in Gherkin (features/02_querying/04_store.feature)
payload.description:
Specs first, red before green; no production code in this task.

**Files:** `features/02_querying/04_store.feature` (new, tagged @wip); `tests/steps/store_steps.rs` (new, todo!() red steps); `src/spec/ch02_querying.rs` (embed the new file — the docs-coverage guardrail); `features/02_querying/README.md` (stale: it still says no scenarios exist).

**Specs:** observable store behavior only: a store opens (creating parent dirs) at a caller-given path; reopening persists previously ingested data; a reader on a second connection keeps querying while an ingest transaction commits (WAL observable); a corrupt or non-store file at the path is a clean typed error, never a panic; the default path derives from BOTSPY_HOME/$HOME as ~/.botspy/store.db (consistent with the CLI's ~/.botspy/snapshots).

**Acceptance:** scenarios reviewed and executable red (todo!() steps); @wip kept so CI still skips the file.

Gates: cargo fmt --all; cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings; RUSTDOCFLAGS="-D warnings" cargo doc --no-deps; cargo test and cargo test --test bdd. All existing suites stay green (features/01_structure, features/03_importers, features/04_examples, features/cli).
